annotations.title: Show how to play a guitar chord

description: Returns playable guitar shapes for a chord name (open position and movable barre shapes), with frets, fingering where known, the notes in the chord and a text chord diagram. Handles major, minor, 7, maj7, m7, sus2, sus4, add9, 6, m6, 9, dim, m7b5, dim7, aug, power chords and slash chords such as G/B.
name: get_chord_shapes
title: Show how to play a guitar chord
